title: Pure Horus
summary: The King's Sarcophagus Horus strategy with Rank 8 Xyz bosses, Links, and generic staples. Every Level 8 Son of Horus Special Summons itself from the GY once per turn without starting a Chain while you control King's Sarcophagus or Walls of the Imperial Tomb.

summary.title: Starters
points: Imsety, Glory of Horus sends itself and another card from your hand to the GY to add King's Sarcophagus from your Deck to your hand and draw 1 card.
Walls of the Imperial Tomb is treated as King's Sarcophagus in the Field Zone and places 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck to search any Horus monster.
King's Sarcophagus sends 1 card from your hand to the GY to send 1 Horus monster from your Deck to the GY up to 4 times per turn.

summary.title: Opening: Imsety, Glory of Horus + 2 Cards
steps: Send Imsety, Glory of Horus and 1 card from your hand to the GY to search King's Sarcophagus and draw 1 card.
Activate King's Sarcophagus, then send 1 or 2 cards from your hand to send Hapi, Guidance of Horus, Duamutef, Blessing of Horus, or Qebehsenuef, Protection of Horus from the Deck to the GY.

Special Summon Imsety and the other Sons of Horus from your GY; either keep them on the field for their removal triggers or overlay two into Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord or Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy.

summary.title: Removal Punishers & Field Presence
summary.text: While multiple Sons of Horus are on the field, removing any other card you control by an opponent's card effect sets off all of them at once: Imsety sends 1 card on the field to the GY, Duamutef gains 1200 ATK/DEF per Horus monster and draws 1 card per monster with a different name in your Main Monster Zones, Hapi returns 2 cards from either GY or banishment to the hand or Deck, and Qebehsenuef prevents your opponent from targeting Horus monsters for attacks or card effects for the turn. Horus the Black Flame Deity sends a card on the field to the GY from the hand while you control a Horus and King's Sarcophagus, and wipes all other monsters when a Horus or King's Sarcophagus leaves the field.

summary.title: Rank 8 Toolbox & Protection
points: King's Sarcophagus prevents your Horus monsters from being destroyed by card effects that do not target them, and sends an opponent's monster to the GY at the start of the Damage Step when it battles a Horus monster.

Two Level 8 Sons of Horus make Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord (monster effect negate), Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy (Spell negate), Divine Dragon Knight Felgrand, Number 68: Sanaphond the Sky Prison, Number 23: Lancelot, Teardrop the Rikka Queen, or S:P Little Knight.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The older Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV4, LV6, and LV8 monsters do not interact with King's Sarcophagus and are omitted.
